It covers an area of 1 ha, and on its southern edge is the city belfry (Halletoren/Belfort), which is one of the city's best known landmarks. There are nice views from the tower (see Do below)","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":51.2087,"lng":3.22439,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"Groeninge Museum","content":"Known as 'The city museum of Fine Arts', it houses a collection of artworks that span several centuries (14th-20th), focusing mainly on works by painters who lived and worked in Bruges.","hours":"Daily 09:30-17:00","price":"/ (audioguide and ticket to Arents House and Forum+ included in the entrance)","url":"https://www.visitbruges.be/en/things-to-do/culture-and-heritage/groeningemuseum-groeninge-museum","lat":51.2061,"lng":3.22639,"wikipedia":"Groeningemuseum","wikidata":"Q1948674"},{"type":"see","name":"Basilica of the Holy Blood (Heilige Bloed Basiliek)","content":"A beautiful church on the Burg square. It houses a relic: a vial of blood that is said to be that of Jesus - and was built in the Gothic style. Try to get there early so you can view the chapel when it is quiet and not filled with tourists. And don't forget to visit the chapel underneath, in heavy Romanesque style - a contrast to the lovely light Gothic above.","hours":"Daily 09:30—12:30 & 14:00—17:30","price":"Free. Museum/Treasure Room:","url":"http://www.holyblood.com/?lang=en","lat":51.20808,"lng":3.226533,"wikipedia":"Basilica of the Holy Blood","wikidata":"Q522604"},{"type":"see","name":"Brewery De Halve Maan","content":"This brewery is the only remaining that's still brewing beer inside the city walls. It's also a beer museum and offers a tour of the beer making process. A history of the brewery is provided, as well as an overview of the city from its tower. The tour lasts for 45 min and is a good way to get a feel for Belgian beer making. The tours start at the exact turn of the hour, be at least 15 minutes early as there is a maximum number of people that can join. The entrance price includes one drink of Brugse Zot or Straffe Hendrik and is served after the tour at the outside terrace or indoor bar. There is a longer version of the tour available at weekends.","hours":"Apr-Oct: Mon-Sat 11:00-16:00, Sun 11:00-17:00","price":"including 1 beer booked on-line","url":"https://www.halvemaan.be/en","lat":51.2026,"lng":3.22416,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"2-be Beer Wall and Bar","content":"On the court of a former major's house, \"all Belgian beers\" are exposed permanently. At the back of the wall, it's also possible to drink a lot of those beers.","hours":"","price":"","url":"http://www.2-be.biz","lat":51.2073,"lng":3.2271,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"Onze Lieve Vrouwkerk","content":"A fascinating church with architecture from the Romanesque and Gothic periods. In the east end of the church are very fine tombs of Charles the Bold and his daughter Mary of Burgundy, in contrasting Gothic and Renaissance styles, despite their superficial similarity. The church also houses one of the few Michelangelo sculptures outside of Italy, the \"Madonna with child\". To see the \"Madonna with Child\" an entrance fee of for 18-26, for 26-64, for over 65, and under 17 is free.","hours":"","price":"Free","url":"","lat":51.204662,"lng":3.224448,"wikipedia":"Church of Our Lady, Bruges","wikidata":"Q917183"},{"type":"see","name":"Simbolik - Open Studio and Expo of Nathalie Beelprez","content":"A house, an open studio where thoughts and ideas are born, a place where Beelprez can mix these thoughts and feelings in a symbolic language of forms, her soul, her calligraphy, her world, her language. While she works in her studio, her expo is open for anyone who wants to let time go, read forms and see letters. An open immersion in texts and forms that excite your senses. Selection of handmade letterwork, wall objects, light objects, painted on canvas, letters in ceramics, writing on walls, also work on demand. Also, every first Sunday of the month at 15:00 is Poëziene: a place where poets, musicians or performers bring their own work to Simbolik.","hours":"Thu-Sat 10:00-18:00, other days by appointment","price":"Free entrance","url":"http://www.simbolik.be/","lat":51.200058,"lng":3.229323,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"Jerusalem church","content":"In a quiet area of the city, a highly unusual church with octagonal tower built by the Adornes brothers, merchants of Italian extraction. It includes a fine black Tournai marble tomb, late Gothic stained glass, and a tiny and rather spooky chapel containing an effigy of the dead Christ. The entrance fee also covers the Lace Museum in the former Adornes mansion, where you can see local women and girls learning this traditional craft.","hours":"Mon-Sat 10:00 - 17:00","price":"Adult €8","url":"http://www.adornes.org/en","lat":51.212336,"lng":3.233679,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"The Beguinage (Begijnhof)","content":"In the history, many women couldn't find a man, as men were more likely to die in accidents or in a war. Those women could \"marry God\" and become a beguine. The beguinage, also known as the convent, offered protection for those single ladies. It lies between the centre of the city and the station, with white painted small houses and fine plane trees, is a quiet place to walk; groups are discouraged.","hours":"","price":"","url":"https://www.visitbruges.be/en/begijnhof-beguinage","lat":51.201268,"lng":3.222765,"wikipedia":"Ten Wijngaerde (Begijnhof Brugge)","wikidata":"Q2528092"},{"type":"see","name":"The Hospital of St John","content":"Sint-Janshospitaal contains a museum of six paintings by Hans Memling, within the early medieval hospital buildings.","hours":"Tue-Sun 09:30-17:00","price":"","url":"https://www.museabrugge.be/en/visit-our-museums/our-museums-and-monuments/sint-janshospitaal","lat":51.203972,"lng":3.224013,"wikipedia":"Old St. John's Hospital","wikidata":"Q2432540"},{"type":"see","name":"Choco-Story Museum","content":"This museum is a must-see for chocolate enthusiasts as it describes chocolate's transition from cocoa into chocolate. Its low-cost tasty exhibits make it well worth the time (and Belcolade's gently overt marketing). Be sure to stay for the chocolate making exhibition to get some excellent samplers. Recommend buying tickets online ahead of time. On a Sunday in October 2022 they didn't have room for walk ins, you needed to buy tickets a few hours ahead of time.","hours":"10:00-17:00","price":"","url":"http://choco-story-brugge.be/en/","lat":51.2107,"lng":3.22625,"wikipedia":"Choco-Story","wikidata":"Q2747092"},{"type":"see","name":"Diamond Museum","content":"Diamond museum has a large range of exhibits ranging from mining all the way to polishing and all the history in between. Everyday at 12:15 there is a live polishing demonstration.","hours":"10:30-17:30","price":"Adult , student","url":"http://www.diamondmuseum.be/","lat":51.202727,"lng":3.225898,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"Lucifernum","content":"An amazing (private) art gallery with a Gothic cemetery in a subtropical garden located in the old Freemasons temple (1756-1882). 1,000 m² of art and mystery in Bruges' old city centre.","hours":"Sun 18:00-21:00","price":"","url":"http://www.lucifernum.be","lat":51.2099,"lng":3.2282,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"see","name":"Kruispoort","content":"Part of the second city ramparts of 1297. The current gate dates back to the beginning of the 15th century.","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":51.21257,"lng":3.2401,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":"Q2185810"},{"type":"see","name":"Smedenpoort","content":"The first gate was built in 1297-1299 but was rebuilt in 1376-1378. After that there were several changes to the building. The gate is completely surrounded by water. A renovation in 2009 made the gate look shining again.","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":51.204588,"lng":3.212321,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":"Q2421775"},{"type":"see","name":"Ezelpoort","content":"Just like the Smedenpoort, this gate is completely surrounded by water. Nowadays the gate is only used by pedestrians and cyclists. The gate previously also was called the Oostendsche Poort (Ostend Gate) since the road through the gate lead to Ostend.","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":51.215449,"lng":3.215672,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":"Q1851037"},{"type":"see","name":"Gentpoort","content":"One of the four remaining city gates of the second city ramparts of 1297. In the gate building is housed a museum.","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":51.203009,"lng":3.234613,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":"Q2105764"},{"type":"do","name":"Grote Markt and Belfry Climb","content":"Climb the 366 steps to the top of the 83-m-high tower. Excellent views of the city, Grote Markt and hear the bells ring up close.","hours":"Tue-Sun 09:30-17:00","price":"for adults 26+; discounts for children & youth.","url":"https://www.museabrugge.be/en/visit/locations/belfort","lat":null,"lng":null,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"do","name":"Canal Tour","content":"To see Bruges from another perspective, take a ride on one of the tour boats around the canals — the multilingual guides provide a potted history of the city in just a few minutes — at only a few euros, it's the best introduction to Bruges. A boat tour will show you places which are otherwise unreachable, as not every canal runs next to a street. Advisable to get there at opening time to avoid the crowds. Cannot be reserved online and all boat tours cost the same.","hours":"","price":"plus almost obligatory tip to the driver/guide","url":"","lat":null,"lng":null,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"do","name":"Horse drawn carts","content":"Carriages can be hired for a romantic 30-minute trip around the old city of Bruges. Carts can carry up to 5 passengers.","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":null,"lng":null,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"do","name":"Ambassadors Tours Bruges","content":"Passionate local storytellers offer tours in the medieval city center. Tell Me Stories About Bruges, daily at 10:00, 11:00, 14:00 & 17:00, operated in English. Bruges at Night: Murder, Mystery & Dark Stories, selected days at 18:00 or 20:00.","hours":"Daily 10:00 - 22:00","price":"Daytime: pay-what-you-want; night €31","url":"https://ambassadorstours.com/en/bruges/","lat":51.20838,"lng":3.22463,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"do","name":"Bruges Ballooning","content":"Daily hot air balloon flights over the historic centre and its surroundings. The best way to enjoy the romance of Bruges, and its stunning views, from a few hundred metres up in a balloon basket.","hours":"Morning and afternoon","price":"","url":"http://www.bruges-ballooning.com","lat":51.2,"lng":3.2,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"do","name":"Cycle","content":"There are many rental shops near the main square, shop around for the best prices. Place where you can buy the original chocolate breasts. Has a nice piece in their window on special occasions.","hours":"","price":"","url":"http://www.chocoladehuisjebrugge.be","lat":51.208057,"lng":3.225505,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"buy","name":"The Chocolate Line","content":"Almost always has original and funny chocolate-art in their window. Run by a (locally) famous chocolatier, Dominique Persoone. Fame comes with a price: The Chocolate Line is quite expensive compared to the many other chocolate stores in Bruges.","hours":"","price":"","url":"http://www.thechocolateline.be","lat":51.206541,"lng":3.222448,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"buy","name":"Rombaux","content":"A record, guitar and piano store, run by a friendly family in a landmark building, incredible atmosphere with a huge collection of jazz, classical but also modern records. They further have a guitar and piano instrument department and a good collection of sheet music.","hours":"","price":"","url":"https://www.rombaux.be/","lat":51.2093627,"lng":3.2276232,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"Books & Brunch","content":"An ideal combo of second hand book store and a brunch/dessert-eatery (but you can just have a cup of coffee or a tea too).","hours":"Tue-Fri 08:30-18:00, Sat 09:00-18:00","price":"","url":"https://www.facebook.com/Booksenbrunch","lat":51.204387,"lng":3.229498,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"The Olive Street Food","content":"An authentic Greek takeaway place just a minute of walking away from the Belfry/Grote Markt. They offer food that is not only well-seasoned and extraordinarily savoury, but also very affordable, especially compared to other places to eat at in the Bruges' historical centre.","hours":"Wed-Mon 12:00-20:30","price":"€8.9 for a medium-sized wrap, €14.9 for a larger box of food (May 2025)","url":"https://www.theolivestreetfood.com/","lat":51.2075768,"lng":3.2260159,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"Brasserie Medard","content":"Huge deal for low budget just near the centre: a mountain of (tasty) spaghetti with tomato sauce, cheese, and mushrooms for . Most tables order the spaghetti. Tourists aren't welcome until they sit: be sure to sit down and impose your presence to be served. If you wait to be seated, you are likely to be sent away for no reason.","hours":"","price":"","url":"","lat":51.208543,"lng":3.222594,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"Le Pain Quotidien","content":"A sandwich chain founded in Brussels but now found in the US, France and a number of other countries. Most of the food is organic, and the sandwiches (in particular the Tartine Bouef Basilic) are delicious. Somewhat expensive.","hours":"","price":"","url":"http://www.lepainquotidien.be/en/store/le-pain-quotidien-simonstevinplein/#.WTO7-OvyjIU","lat":51.206386,"lng":3.22264,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"The Potato Bar","content":"One of the better fries shops (frietkoten/frituren) Bruges has to offer. Both classic fries with mayonnaise as well as burgers and fries with a variety of toppings available. Vegetarian options.","hours":"","price":"€3-4.5 for fries with toppings, €8-11 for a burger (Sept 2021)","url":"https://www.the-potato-bar.be","lat":51.2083565,"lng":3.2168749,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"Cropains","content":"Not much indoor seating, but delicious \"croque monsieurs\" (grilled sandwiches) and wraps, with vegetarian options.","hours":"","price":"€6-€8 for a grilled sandwich or wrap","url":"https://www.cropains.com/","lat":51.208799,"lng":3.222102,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"Brasserie Forestière","content":"Nice and calm restaurant, good food, not too expensive. They have some of the best selection of Belgian beers, more than 440 in total. Some beers have really odd names like Satan, Lucifer, Nostradamus, or the Brunette. It's primarily a restaurant though, as all their hearty food are prepared with a special kind of beer. It's really delicious. Make a reservation in advance, as else they might not have any seats available.","hours":"11:00-23:00 daily","price":"","url":"http://www.cambrinus.eu/","lat":51.209598,"lng":3.226134,"wikipedia":"","wikidata":""},{"type":"eat","name":"Grand Cafe Passage","content":"Attached to the Passage hotel/hostel (see below) is the atmospheric Grand Café, serving traditional Belgian cuisine and beers.
